✦ Our Story

Allentown's Trusted Halal Butcher

For over a decade, Aryan Halal Meat has been proudly serving Allentown families with 100% Zabihah Halal certified meats. We hand-slaughter every cut on-site, following strict Islamic guidelines and prioritizing humane animal treatment.

Our onsite butcher meticulously prepares each order to your exact preference — whether you need specific cuts, trimming, thickness, or whole animals for special occasions.

✓
100% Zabihah Certified Hand-slaughtered, verified halal
🌿
Antibiotic & Hormone Free Sourced from trusted local farms
🔪
Custom Butchery Cut exactly to your specifications
📦
Local Delivery Available Same-day pickup or delivery

✦ Place Your Order

Order Fresh Today

Order online for in-store pickup or local Allentown delivery. We'll confirm your order by phone within 2 hours.

Why Order With Us?

Our master butchers hand-cut every order. We source directly from farms we trust, ensuring every animal is raised humanely and slaughtered according to Zabihah standards.

All cuts are fresh, never frozen for primary items. We pack orders carefully and deliver same-day when possible.

Payment Methods Accepted:

💳 Visa · MC · Apple Pay · PayPal · Venmo · Zelle · 💵 Cash
